context: Defines how tiles and objects are rendered and simplified at different zoom levels.
description: Integrates Unreal World Partition and Hierarchical LOD (HLOD) to ensure smooth transitions when zooming between local, regional and national views.

classes.name: LODManager
classes.description: Determines which representation (full detail, simplified, impostor) to use for terrain, vegetation and buildings.

methods.name: SelectTerrainLOD(distance)
methods.description: Select appropriate terrain mesh resolution based on camera distance.
methods.pseudocode: If distance > farThreshold: use HLOD or impostor; else if distance > midThreshold: use simplified mesh; else: use full resolution.

methods.name: SelectVegetationLOD(distance)
methods.pseudocode: If distance is far: draw as billboard or blob; else: draw instanced meshes.

methods.name: SelectBuildingLOD(distance)
methods.description: Select building mesh LOD using the HLOD system.
methods.pseudocode: Use Unreal HLOD clusters: high LOD near the camera; coarse mesh far away.

pseudocode: For each object type, choose an LOD representation based on camera distance and zoom level.
